- VLESS + Vision (raycontrol REALITY too): UDP now goes in XUDP, as Xray expects; before, Xray refused it, so calls, games and QUIC did not go through such a profile
- Packet encoding "none" (the default when a link does not set packetEncoding) means XUDP under Vision; packet and xudp stay as chosen
- CI: UDP through REALITY + Vision against Xray; NaiveProxy with a wrong password must get a 404 on CONNECT from rayd naive; niko-server checks run against v0.1.2 from arngory/niko-server
